name: Barrier ward
description: An Agency device that seals crime scenes, deployed from two ends, used by Kaya and Etrata to bind Oba.

timeline.summary: Kaya finds an Agency barrier ward and deploys it around Oba, arguing Vitu-Ghazi is a crime scene under the Agency's authority.
timeline.quote: "No," she said and hit the button to deploy the barrier.

timeline.summary: Etrata, who had been playing dead, rises and activates the second barrier ward anchor so the two can pin Oba.
timeline.quote: She hit the button as she climbed to her feet, and more ribbons lashed out, twining around Oba
